title: From Letter-of-Credit Requirements to Executable Specifications: Evaluating Verification Accuracy and Completeness
abstract: arXiv:2611.26988v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In letter-of-credit (LC) document examination, a correct final decision does not show that every requirement was examined. We therefore evaluate examination requirement by requirement and make each requirement executable. A language model converts the bill of lading (BL) and commercial invoice (IV) requirements of a credit into atomic conditions and logical structures, and a deterministic verifier retrieves the named evidence and computes each outcome, so every check can be compared with a gold encoding and traced to logged evidence. Because LC records are confidential, our on-premises 9B parser is fine-tuned only on synthetic pairs built from templates and human-reviewed public document values. On 345 real LC cases, final-decision accuracy proves misleading: a constant PASS rule has the highest raw accuracy while examining nothing. translated_title: 从信用证要求到可执行规范：评估验证的准确性与完整性
translated_abstract: 在信用证（LC）单据审核中，正确的最终决定并不能表明每一项要求都经过了审核。因此，我们逐条评估审核要求，并将每项要求变为可执行的。语言模型将信用证中的提单（BL）和商业发票（IV）要求转换为原子条件和逻辑结构，再由确定性验证器检索指定的证据并计算每项结果，使得每项检查都可以与黄金编码进行对比并追溯至日志记录的证据。由于信用证记录是保密的，我们本地部署的9B解析器仅在基于模板和人工审核的公开文档值构建的合成数据对上进行微调。在345个真实信用证案例上，最终决定准确率被证明具有误导性：一个恒定输出PASS的规则拥有最高的原始准确率，却什么都没有审核。尽管微调后的解析器在训练期间从未见过真实记录，它仍检测出93%的原子要求……
tldr: 该论文将信用证审核要求逐条转化为可执行的原子条件并结合确定性验证器实现可追溯审核，揭示了仅以最终决定准确率衡量审核的误导性，并在数据保密条件下通过仅用合成数据微调的本地9B解析器达到93%的原子要求检测率。
en_tdlr: This paper converts letter-of-credit examination requirements into executable atomic conditions verified by a deterministic checker, revealing that final-decision accuracy is misleading, and achieves 93% atomic-requirement detection with a locally fine-tuned 9B parser trained solely on synthetic data.
